banlist.intro: Banning certain cards aims to preserve the balance and integrity of the format. When a card generates excessive advantage, reduces interaction, or limits strategic diversity, it can harm the quality of games. Bans help maintain a healthy, competitive environment true to the format's spirit.
banlist.asCommanderDesc: The following cards are banned as commanders in Pauper Duel Commander, as their permanent access from the command zone creates an excessive advantage and harms the balance and diversity of the format.
banlist.inDeckDesc: The following cards are banned in the deck in Pauper Duel Commander, as their impact is deemed too powerful or too restrictive for the format, harming balance, interaction, and strategic diversity.

rules.title: Format Rules
rules.subtitle: How Pauper Duel Commander is framed: the basics, the mechanics we keep, and what qualifies for the Command Zone.
rules.basicsDesc: The deckbuilding constraints checked by the deck validator.
rules.mechanicsDesc: Some cross-cutting mechanics need a format-specific ruling. These are the decisions we made, based on the tournaments played so far and feedback from regular players.
rules.ttiRecall: A mechanic introduced in Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate. Like the Monarch, it is a status that passes from player to player through a "Take the Initiative" effect or through combat damage dealt to the player holding it.
rules.ttiPoint1: It acts as a pay-off for many decks, particularly in certain colors.
rules.ttiPoint2: It makes winning far easier when the status never changes hands — and changing hands is hard, since it requires meeting at least one of the two conditions.
rules.ttiPoint3: There is no way to interact with the status.
rules.ttiDecision: As a result, this mechanic is not included in the format.
rules.monarchIntro: The Monarch, a mechanic similar to Take the Initiative, raises comparable questions. It nonetheless strikes us as less overwhelming.
rules.monarchBalance: The card advantage it provides is quickly offset by the generally low power level of the format's cards.
rules.monarchWatch: We are keeping an eye on it, as it may prove too favorable to certain color identities.
rules.czDesc: After much discussion, we decided not to restrict the Command Zone.
rules.czCreatures: Creatures, legendary or not, that have been printed at uncommon at least once.
rules.czVehicles: Vehicles and Spacecraft, on the same terms.
rules.czBans: In exchange, targeted bans keep this zone as balanced as possible.
